version.changelog: Sync skill instructions, references, and helper from GitHub f539cc161541589c5d112646b349f89112f70b4f

llm.summary: This skill is a narrow soccer match analysis helper that calls a disclosed Crawlora/SofaScore API through a constrained read-only script.

dimensions.detail: Use requires a Crawlora API key and sends match search queries or event identifiers to https://api.crawlora.net, which is expected for this API-backed workflow and is disclosed in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions, an endpoint reference, and one local Bash helper using curl; there are no dependency installs, remote code execution steps, or hidden setup actions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives bounded analysis instructions and warns against over-interpreting aggregate match statistics; the helper script allowlists only the documented SofaScore GET routes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background service, memory writing, system modification, privilege escalation, or destructive behavior was found; chmod 600 is used only to restrict a temporary curl config containing the API key.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is post-match soccer performance analysis, and the artifacts only describe fetching SofaScore search, event, statistics, incidents, lineups, head-to-head, team-events, and odds data for that analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should be comfortable providing a Crawlora API key and sending soccer match lookup parameters to Crawlora. The skill is read-only for local and sports data purposes, but users should avoid placing private or unrelated information in match search queries.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill uses a shell helper, but the artifact narrows it to documented GET-only Crawlora SofaScore routes and does not ask for broad mutation authority.
[E1] expected: External API calls are central to the skill's purpose and are disclosed; the data sent appears limited to the Crawlora API key plus match search/query parameters.
[PE2] expected: The cited chmod 600 command is not sudo or root execution; it reduces exposure of a temporary config file and is removed on exit.
